state.instructions: Go to the shop, find a blue sweatshirt, select size large, and get the price. Do it in these steps: 1. Open the shop's home page. 2. Point the mouse at a menu entry at the top of the page so that its menu opens, then click the entry for sweatshirts in that menu. 3. Scroll down the list until you see a blue sweatshirt, then click it. 4. On the product page, click the size L button. 5. Point at the price to read it into `state.price`. 6. Stop. Never add anything to the bag and never open the checkout.

__tool__.instructions: Which action best advances `instructions`, given `state` and `previous_actions`?

criteria.navigate: Opens one of the web addresses in the options in the browser.
criteria.click: Clicks one element of the web page, which is the picture in `state.screen`.
criteria.hover: Moves the mouse pointer onto one element of the web page, which is the picture in `state.screen`, without clicking: menus open this way.
criteria.scroll: Scrolls the web page in the browser to see another part of it.
criteria.press_key: Presses one key of the keyboard in the browser, for example to submit a form.
criteria.go_back: Goes back to the previous web page in the browser history.
criteria.read_price: Reads the price of the item from the web page, which is the picture in `state.screen`.
criteria.end: Stops, because `instructions` have been carried out according to `state`, or cannot be carried out.
